guideSights.name: Palace of Knossos
guideSights.content: If you see just one ruin on Crete, see Knossos (in Greek it’s Κνωσός, stress is on the second syllable). The site is fairly compact, and much of it is accessible with restricted mobility. But 30 minutes will do it. It is one of six Minoan P

guideSights.name: Koules
guideSights.hours: Daily 08:00-20:00, limited hours during off season
guideSights.content: Koules (Greek: Κούλες) was built by the Venetians in the 16th C. From the parapet, enjoy the view towards Dia Islet, where Jacques Cousteau found many sunken remains of Cretan sea trade.

guideSights.name: Fortifications of Heraklion

guideSights.name: Historical Museum of Crete
guideSights.hours: summer (Apr–Oct) Mon,Wed–Fr 10:00-17:00, Sat-Sun 11:00-17:00; winter (Nov–Mar) Mon–Fr 09:00-15:30, Sat-Sun 10:00-16:00
guideSights.price: €7.50 full, €4.50 concession, children 12 and under: free
guideSights.content: Covers the story of Crete from the Byzantine era to the present day. It includes material on World War II and the German occupation, which was displayed in the “Museum of the Battle for Crete and National Resistance” until it closed.

guideSights.name: Natural History Museum of Crete
guideSights.content: The Natural History Museum of Crete shows the natural environment of the Eastern Mediterranean area with a special emphasis on Greece and Crete.

guideSights.name: University of Crete

guideSights.name: O Kafenes tou Kagiampi
guideSights.content: Old fashioned tavern with traditional Greek dishes.

guideSights.name: Kafeneio O Ntokos
guideSights.content: Tiny place next to the fish market with delicious mezedes to accompany your beer or raki.

guideSights.name: Kafeneio O Lakkos
guideSights.content: Lost in a maze of small streets where different street artists have decorated the walls of the houses, Lakkos is particularly nice in the summer.

guideSights.name: Pagopiion

guideSights.name: Ippokampos
guideSights.content: Seafood and fish tavern by the sea side, popular with the locals.

guideSights.name: Herbs' Garden
